summary: Explains `serial` for rolling updates: Ansible runs the whole play on a batch of hosts before moving to the next batch. With `serial: 3` and 6 hosts, both tasks finish on 3 hosts before the next 3.
questions: How do I update only a few servers at a time?
How do I do a rolling update with Ansible?
With serial, does each batch run the whole play before the next batch starts?

answer_card.title: Batch hosts with serial
answer_card.answer_md:
By default a play runs in parallel against all hosts in `hosts:`. Use `serial` to manage a few at a time:

```yaml
- name: test play
  hosts: webservers
  serial: 3
  gather_facts: False
  tasks:
    - command: hostname
    - command: hostname
```
With 6 webservers, Ansible runs the **entire play** (both tasks) on 3 hosts, then on the next 3.
